coverage: Candidate text for the currently identified calculator surfaces. Final wording, placement, and inclusion follow the open product decisions; this catalog does not approve new behavior.

quick.expression.placeholder.meaning: Invites the user to enter a mathematical expression.
quick.expression.placeholder.context: Shown only while the quick input is empty.
quick.expression.placeholder.location: Inside the centered quick calculation input.

quick.expression.accessibleName.meaning: Names the mathematical input for assistive technology.
quick.expression.accessibleName.context: Read when the quick input receives focus, including when a value is present.
quick.expression.accessibleName.location: Accessible name of the quick input; not an extra visible label.

quick.result.label.meaning: Identifies the value produced by the current expression.
quick.result.label.context: Used only when a valid result for the current expression is available. The result line is empty for unfinished input, and an earlier result must not stand in for the current one. Decimal formatting and reduced opacity of trailing digits are handled separately from this label.
quick.result.label.location: Result line directly below the quick input.

result.boolean.true.meaning: Displays a logical result whose value is true.
result.boolean.true.context: Used when the current valid calculation produces a logical value, such as 5 > 3. This is display text; accepted input literals and clipboard serialization are specified separately.
result.boolean.true.location: The active calculation result, directly below quick input or in the result area associated with an expression in a calculation sheet.

result.boolean.false.meaning: Displays a logical result whose value is false.
result.boolean.false.context: Used when the current valid calculation produces a logical value, such as 5 < 3. This is a valid result, not an error or a missing result. Accepted input literals and clipboard serialization are specified separately.
result.boolean.false.location: The active calculation result, directly below quick input or in the result area associated with an expression in a calculation sheet.

completion.list.accessibleName.meaning: Names the list of suggested expression completions for assistive technology.
completion.list.accessibleName.context: Used when suggestions open from the first letter in quick or multiline input, or immediately after a complete :: or to conversion operator. Up to seven rows are visible; arrow selection scrolls to keep the active option visible. While open, Up and Down select, Tab accepts, and Escape closes only the suggestions. Compatible target units are suggested after a conversion operator; comments do not open suggestions. Search ordering is still being specified.
completion.list.accessibleName.location: Accessible name of the suggestion list aligned beneath the currently typed word. One frame surrounds the list, which overlays following text without shifting it and may cross the input area's lower boundary. A visible heading is not required.

completion.showDescription.meaning: Opens the complete description of the selected suggestion when the inline text is shortened.
completion.showDescription.context: Available for a selected suggestion with a description. The complete text must be accessible by keyboard as well as pointer hover; the exact shortcut and presentation are still being specified. User-authored descriptions remain in their original language.
completion.showDescription.location: Command or keyboard help associated with the selected suggestion. The exact control placement belongs to the full interface prototype.

completion.function.sin.description.text: Sine. Enter the angle in degrees.
completion.function.sin.description.meaning: Explains that the ordinary sine call takes its unmarked numeric argument in degrees.
completion.function.sin.description.context: Shown when the sine function is suggested. Ordinary input such as sin(30) uses degrees without a suffix; explicitly marked radian input such as sin(pi/2 rad) is also supported. Both behaviors were reconfirmed in expression-language round 15. The typed matching prefix is visually reduced in opacity; the proposed continuation is fully opaque.
completion.function.sin.description.location: Immediately after the complete sine signature in the same suggestion row, separated by a gap. The description uses the same font size, lighter weight and reduced opacity, with no shared-column or right-edge alignment.

completion.function.sqrt.description.text: Square root of a nonnegative number.
completion.function.sqrt.description.meaning: Explains the square root function within the calculator's real-number domain.
completion.function.sqrt.description.context: Description shown when the square root function is suggested. Negative real arguments are outside the accepted numeric domain. The typed matching prefix is visually reduced in opacity; the proposed continuation is fully opaque.
completion.function.sqrt.description.location: Immediately after the complete square-root signature in the same suggestion row, separated by a gap. The description uses the same font size, lighter weight and reduced opacity, with no shared-column or right-edge alignment.

completion.unit.squareMetre.description.meaning: Identifies a square metre as a unit of area.
completion.unit.squareMetre.description.context: Shown for an unambiguous metre area or volume unit. Lowercase m2/m3 and their active-locale counterparts display as superscript metre symbols and never mean squared or cubed minutes. Tab inserts the displayed unit spelling. A caret instead raises a whole quantity to a power. Autoreplacement boundaries and behavior for other units remain under discussion.
completion.unit.squareMetre.description.location: Immediately after the unit spelling in the same suggestion row, separated by a gap. Same font size, lighter weight and reduced opacity, without column or right-edge alignment.

completion.unit.cubicMetre.description.meaning: Identifies a cubic metre as a unit of volume.
completion.unit.cubicMetre.description.context: Shown for an unambiguous metre area or volume unit. Lowercase m2/m3 and their active-locale counterparts display as superscript metre symbols and never mean squared or cubed minutes. Tab inserts the displayed unit spelling. A caret instead raises a whole quantity to a power. Autoreplacement boundaries and behavior for other units remain under discussion.
completion.unit.cubicMetre.description.location: Immediately after the unit spelling in the same suggestion row, separated by a gap. Same font size, lighter weight and reduced opacity, without column or right-edge alignment.

completion.unit.squareCentimetre.descrip.meaning: Identifies a square centimetre as a unit of area.
completion.unit.squareCentimetre.descrip.context: Shown when the square-centimetre unit is identified and offered as a completion. The candidate displays and inserts a superscript unit symbol. A caret expression applies exponentiation to a quantity and must not be treated as an equivalent completion spelling. Contextual lowercase m inference and the exact scope of shorthand autoformatting are defined separately.
completion.unit.squareCentimetre.descrip.location: Immediately after the unit spelling in the same suggestion row, separated by a gap. Same font size, lighter weight and reduced opacity, without column or right-edge alignment.

completion.unit.cubicCentimetre.descript.meaning: Identifies a cubic centimetre as a unit of volume.
completion.unit.cubicCentimetre.descript.context: Shown when the cubic-centimetre unit is identified and offered as a completion. The candidate displays and inserts a superscript unit symbol. A caret expression applies exponentiation to a quantity and must not be treated as an equivalent completion spelling. Contextual lowercase m inference and the exact scope of shorthand autoformatting are defined separately.
completion.unit.cubicCentimetre.descript.location: Immediately after the unit spelling in the same suggestion row, separated by a gap. Same font size, lighter weight and reduced opacity, without column or right-edge alignment.

quick.history.show.context: Available when history is collapsed. Arrow Up in quick mode opens history automatically and starts history navigation only when the suggestion menu is closed; an open suggestion menu uses the arrows to select a completion.
quick.history.show.location: Command menu or keyboard hint associated with quick input.

quick.history.hide.meaning: Collapses history while retaining the quick input.
quick.history.hide.context: Available when history is expanded. Returning with Arrow Down to the empty new input also collapses history automatically.
quick.history.hide.location: Command menu or keyboard hint associated with expanded history.

quick.sheet.open.meaning: Switches to a calculation with variables and multiple expressions.
quick.sheet.open.context: Used by a separate mode-entry command with a modifier; its exact shortcut is undecided. A new sheet starts with the current expression at the same screen position and expands downward. A previously hidden sheet remains available without losing its contents.

quick.hide.meaning: Dismisses the visible calculator without naming a full application exit.
quick.hide.context: Used by Escape when suggestions are closed, the repeated summon shortcut, or a click on another application. If suggestions are open, the first Escape closes only the suggestions. The unfinished input is preserved when the calculator hides.
quick.hide.location: Command menu or keyboard help; not standard window chrome.

definitions.saveConstant.meaning: Saves a user-defined named value for reuse in future calculations.
definitions.saveConstant.context: Invoked explicitly for a constant definition. Assigning a local sheet variable alone does not save a reusable constant. Selection rules remain to be specified.
definitions.saveConstant.location: Definition actions associated with the calculation editor; the exact menu placement is not yet specified.

definitions.saveFunction.meaning: Saves a user-defined calculation rule for future calls by name.
definitions.saveFunction.context: Invoked explicitly for a function definition, which may use the short form or a multiline body with local intermediate values and a final result expression. Detailed save flow remains to be specified.
definitions.saveFunction.location: Definition actions associated with the calculation editor; the exact menu placement is not yet specified.

copy.result.meaning: Copies the selected valid calculation result.
copy.result.context: Available when a result can be copied.
copy.result.location: Result actions in quick input, history, or a calculation sheet.

copy.success.meaning: Confirms that the clipboard write succeeded.
copy.success.context: Shown or announced only after successful copying.
copy.success.location: Brief feedback near the active result; live region for assistive technology.

copy.error.text: Could not copy the result. Try again.
copy.error.meaning: Reports that writing the result to the clipboard failed.
copy.error.context: Shown when copying fails; it must not claim success.
copy.error.location: Feedback area near the active result.

expression.invalid.meaning: Reports an expression that cannot be parsed.
expression.invalid.context: Shown for a syntax error after the agreed validation trigger.
expression.invalid.location: Diagnostic area associated with the current expression.

expression.divisionByZero.meaning: Explains why division cannot produce a result.
expression.divisionByZero.context: Shown when the current expression attempts division by zero during evaluation. The expression has no copyable result. An unselected conditional branch is not evaluated and must not trigger this message.
expression.divisionByZero.location: Diagnostic area for the affected expression or sheet line.

expression.unknownName.meaning: Reports an identifier that the calculation cannot resolve.
expression.unknownName.context: Shown when an expression refers to an undefined name.
expression.unknownName.location: Diagnostic area for the affected expression or sheet line.

placeholders.name: An identifier exactly as written by the user in the calculation. Preserve its spelling and do not translate the inserted value.

expression.domainError.text: This operation is not defined for these values
expression.domainError.meaning: Reports values outside the supported mathematical domain.
expression.domainError.context: Shown when a supported operation cannot accept the supplied values.
expression.domainError.location: Diagnostic area for the affected expression or sheet line.

expression.incompatibleUnits.meaning: Reports a conversion between incompatible measurement dimensions.
expression.incompatibleUnits.context: Shown when the requested unit conversion is invalid.
expression.incompatibleUnits.location: Diagnostic area associated with the conversion expression.

expression.unknownUnit.meaning: Reports a measurement unit that the calculator does not recognize.
expression.unknownUnit.context: Shown when a conversion uses an unsupported unit token.
expression.unknownUnit.location: Diagnostic area associated with the conversion expression.

placeholders.unit: A unit token exactly as written in the expression. Preserve the token; accepted unit spellings are defined by the expression language.

expression.precisionLimit.meaning: Explains that an entered number exceeds the supported numeric precision.
expression.precisionLimit.context: Shown for decimal input exceeding the supported 30-significant-digit precision. The input must not be silently truncated. Integer magnitude is checked independently of the number of written digits in the selected base and uses the dedicated integer-limit diagnostic. Exact rounding at the working-precision boundary remains under discussion.
expression.precisionLimit.location: Diagnostic area for the affected expression or sheet line.

expression.limit.text: This calculation exceeds the supported limits
expression.limit.meaning: Explains that evaluation stopped at a configured computational limit.
expression.limit.context: Shown when an expression is rejected for exceeding the supported complexity or evaluation budget. Long-running calculation mode is excluded; exact resource thresholds remain to be specified.
expression.limit.location: Diagnostic area for the affected calculation.

history.title.meaning: Names the list of past calculations.
history.title.context: Shown when the history view is expanded.
history.title.location: Heading of the history region above the stationary quick input. Initially the newest entry is closest to the input; Arrow Up shifts the list downward into the console and Arrow Down shifts it upward.

history.empty.context: Shown when history contains no saved entries.

history.search.placeholder.meaning: Invites a search among past calculations.
history.search.placeholder.context: Available if history search is included in the final interaction design.
history.search.placeholder.location: Search input inside the history region.

history.search.accessibleName.context: Read when the history search field receives focus.
history.search.accessibleName.location: Accessible name of the history search input.

history.noMatches.meaning: Explains why a nonempty history search displays no entries.
history.noMatches.context: Shown when the search returns no matches.

history.entry.accessibleName.meaning: Announces a historical expression together with its recorded result.
history.entry.accessibleName.context: Read when an existing history entry is selected.
history.entry.accessibleName.location: Accessible name of a calculation history entry.

placeholders.expression: A mathematical expression taken from calculation history. Do not translate, reorder, or modify the inserted expression.
placeholders.result: The formatted value recorded for a calculation. Preserve the inserted value; numeric formatting is handled separately.

history.reuse.meaning: Recalls a previous expression for further input.
history.reuse.context: Used for a selected history entry. The recalled expression is edited as a copy; the original history entry stays unchanged. Recording the new calculation is specified separately.
history.reuse.location: Actions associated with a history entry.

history.delete.context: Available in history management; undo behavior is undecided.
history.delete.location: Actions associated with a history entry.

history.clear.title.meaning: Identifies a proposed confirmation for clearing history.
history.clear.title.context: Draft text for a confirmation if that flow is selected.
history.clear.title.location: Title of the history clearing dialog.

sheet.title.meaning: Names a multi-expression calculation with variables.
sheet.title.context: Used as the generic extended-mode heading.
sheet.title.location: Heading of the extended calculation view.

sheet.name.label.meaning: Labels the user-defined name of a calculation sheet.
sheet.name.label.context: Shown when creating or renaming a saved sheet.
sheet.name.label.location: Label next to the sheet name field.

sheet.name.placeholder.meaning: Invites a name for a calculation sheet.
sheet.name.placeholder.context: Shown while a sheet name field is empty.

sheet.editor.accessibleName.meaning: Names the editor for variables and expressions.
sheet.editor.accessibleName.context: Read when the extended editor receives focus.
sheet.editor.accessibleName.location: Accessible name of the sheet editor.

sheet.new.context: Used from sheet management; the current draft policy is undecided.

sheet.save.meaning: Saves the current sheet as a reusable local calculation.
sheet.save.context: Available if explicit saving is part of the agreed persistence flow.

sheet.rename.meaning: Changes the saved name of a sheet.
sheet.rename.context: Available for a named calculation sheet.

sheet.duplicate.meaning: Creates a separate copy of a calculation sheet.
sheet.duplicate.context: Available if sheet duplication is included in the final design.

sheet.delete.context: Available in sheet management; confirmation and recovery are undecided.

sheet.saveAsTemplate.meaning: Creates a reusable calculation template from a sheet.
sheet.saveAsTemplate.context: Used when saving a calculation as a template; parameter rules are undecided.

sheet.saved.meaning: Confirms that the sheet was persisted successfully.
sheet.saved.context: Shown or announced after a successful save.

sheet.saveError.meaning: Reports failure to persist the calculation sheet.
sheet.saveError.context: Shown when a save attempt fails.

sheet.cycle.text: These expressions depend on each other
sheet.cycle.meaning: Explains a circular dependency that prevents automatic recalculation.
sheet.cycle.context: Available for cyclic dependencies if the final sheet model allows references requiring this check.
sheet.cycle.location: Diagnostics for the affected sheet expressions.

templates.empty.context: Shown when no templates have been saved.

templates.search.placeholder.meaning: Invites a search by template name.
templates.search.placeholder.context: Shown while the template search field is empty.
templates.search.placeholder.location: Search input in the template browser.

templates.search.accessibleName.meaning: Names the template search input for assistive technology.
templates.search.accessibleName.context: Read when the template search field receives focus.
templates.search.accessibleName.location: Accessible name of the template search input.

templates.noMatches.meaning: Explains that a template search has no matches.
templates.noMatches.context: Shown for a search returning no templates.

templates.name.label.meaning: Labels the name of a saved calculation template.
templates.name.label.context: Shown when saving or renaming a template.
templates.name.label.location: Label next to the template name field.

templates.name.placeholder.context: Shown while the template name field is empty.

templates.use.meaning: Starts a calculation using the selected template.
templates.use.context: Used after choosing a template; instance and parameter behavior is undecided.

templates.duplicate.meaning: Creates a separate reusable template copy.
templates.duplicate.context: Available if template duplication is selected in the final design.

templates.delete.context: Available in template management; confirmation and recovery are undecided.

templates.saved.context: Shown or announced after a template is saved.

templates.saveError.meaning: Reports failure to persist a template.
templates.saveError.context: Shown when saving a template fails.

settings.open.context: Available through the application command menu or tray/menu bar entry.
settings.open.location: Application actions menu; not permanent quick-input chrome.

settings.theme.label.location: Label next to the theme control.

settings.theme.system.meaning: Makes appearance follow the operating system preference.
settings.theme.system.context: Draft option pending agreement on system-theme support.

settings.language.label.meaning: Labels the language used for application text.
settings.language.label.context: Shown in language preferences; it does not label mathematical syntax.
settings.language.label.location: Label next to the interface language control.

settings.language.en.context: Shown among the available interface languages.
settings.language.en.location: Option in the interface language control.

settings.language.ru.context: Shown among the available interface languages.
settings.language.ru.location: Option in the interface language control.

settings.shortcuts.title.context: Shown in preferences for keyboard behavior.
settings.shortcuts.title.location: Heading of the shortcut settings section.

settings.shortcuts.open.meaning: Labels the global combination used to summon the calculator.
settings.shortcuts.open.context: Shown while configuring the global shortcut.
settings.shortcuts.open.location: Label next to the global shortcut recorder.

settings.shortcuts.copy.meaning: Labels the combination used to copy a result.
settings.shortcuts.copy.context: Shown while configuring calculation confirmation and copying.
settings.shortcuts.copy.location: Label next to the copy shortcut control.

settings.shortcuts.capture.meaning: Invites the user to record a keyboard combination.
settings.shortcuts.capture.context: Shown while a shortcut recorder is awaiting input.

settings.shortcuts.unavailable.text: This shortcut is unavailable. Choose another.
settings.shortcuts.unavailable.meaning: Reports that the proposed keyboard combination could not be accepted.
settings.shortcuts.unavailable.context: Shown after failed registration or validation; the exact cause may be unknown.

settings.shortcuts.current.meaning: Describes the currently configured keyboard combination.
settings.shortcuts.current.context: Shown or announced when reviewing a shortcut setting.

placeholders.shortcut: A keyboard combination formatted for the current operating system. Do not translate modifier symbols or hard-code Control or Command.

settings.copyBehavior.label.meaning: Labels the preferred window behavior after a successful copy.
settings.copyBehavior.label.context: Draft setting pending agreement on the copying flow.
settings.copyBehavior.label.location: Label next to the post-copy behavior control.

settings.copyBehavior.keep.meaning: Leaves the calculator visible after copying.
settings.copyBehavior.keep.context: Draft choice if post-copy window behavior is configurable.
settings.copyBehavior.keep.location: Option in the post-copy behavior control.

settings.copyBehavior.hide.meaning: Dismisses the calculator after copying succeeds.
settings.copyBehavior.hide.context: Draft choice if post-copy window behavior is configurable.
settings.copyBehavior.hide.location: Option in the post-copy behavior control.

settings.autostart.label.meaning: Labels automatic background startup after user login.
settings.autostart.label.context: Draft setting pending agreement on application startup.
settings.autostart.label.location: Label next to the autostart control.

settings.saveError.meaning: Reports failure to persist a preference change.

data.title.meaning: Groups controls for locally stored calculations and preferences.
data.title.location: Heading of the data management section.

data.localDescription.text: History, sheets, templates, and settings are stored on this device.
data.localDescription.meaning: Explains the accepted local storage model.
data.localDescription.context: Shown when the user reviews storage and transfer options.
data.localDescription.location: Description in the data management section.

data.export.meaning: Starts transferring local application data to a file.
data.export.context: Used to move data between devices; export selection and format are undecided.

data.import.meaning: Starts loading previously exported application data.
data.import.context: Used to transfer data from another installation; conflict rules are undecided.

data.export.success.meaning: Confirms that an export file was written successfully.

data.export.error.context: Shown when an export file cannot be produced.

data.import.success.meaning: Confirms that imported data was accepted and saved.
data.import.success.context: Shown only after import and persistence succeed.

data.import.error.meaning: Reports that the selected file could not be imported.
data.import.error.context: Shown when reading, validating, or applying an import fails; detailed diagnostics may be added later.

data.import.unsupported.text: This file uses an unsupported data format
data.import.unsupported.meaning: Explains that an import format or version is unsupported.
data.import.unsupported.context: Shown when the file cannot be interpreted by the current data format reader.

app.show.meaning: Opens the calculator from application management.
app.show.context: Used as an alternative to the global keyboard shortcut.
app.show.location: Tray or menu bar application menu.

app.quit.meaning: Ends the background application rather than hiding its window.
app.quit.context: Used when the user explicitly exits the application.
app.quit.location: Tray or menu bar application menu.

common.save.meaning: Confirms saving the item currently being edited.
common.save.context: Used only in a dialog whose heading names the item and whose action persists it.
common.save.location: Primary action of a save or rename dialog.

common.cancel.meaning: Dismisses a pending dialog action without confirming it.
common.cancel.context: Used in save, rename, import, or deletion dialogs where cancellation is available.

common.delete.meaning: Confirms removal of the item named by the surrounding dialog.
common.delete.context: Draft action for deletion confirmation; recovery semantics are undecided.
common.delete.location: Destructive action inside an item-specific confirmation dialog.

common.close.meaning: Dismisses an auxiliary dialog or view.
common.close.context: Used only for auxiliary views; it is not a window control on the quick calculator.
common.close.location: Dismiss action of an auxiliary view or dialog.

common.retry.context: Available next to a recoverable error when retry is supported.
common.retry.location: Action in an error feedback region.

completion.base.bin.description.meaning: Identifies the base-2 representation of a number, not a physical unit of measurement.
completion.base.bin.description.context: Description for conversion target bin, identical in all interface languages. After a complete :: or to operator, suggestions open immediately without waiting for a target letter. Integer values without a unit are offered bin, oct, dec and hex; quantities with units are offered compatible units instead. Nondecimal targets are not offered for fractional values. error.baseRequiresInteger.meaning: Explains why a fractional result cannot be represented in one of the supported nondecimal formats.
error.baseRequiresInteger.context: Shown for a completed expression requesting a binary, octal or hexadecimal result when the numeric value is not an integer, such as 10.5::hex. The value must not be rounded or truncated to make the conversion succeed.
error.baseRequiresInteger.location: Calculation diagnostic associated with the conversion expression; no valid result is available to copy.

error.invalidBaseDigit.text: Character {character} is not valid in base {base}
error.invalidBaseDigit.meaning: Identifies a character that cannot be a digit in the explicitly prefixed number.
error.invalidBaseDigit.context: Shown for an invalid prefixed number such as 0b102 under the existing completed-expression error rule. A prefix with no digits, such as 0b, is incomplete input and must not trigger this error.
error.invalidBaseDigit.location: Calculation diagnostic associated with the invalid numeric literal; no valid result is available to copy.

placeholders.character: The offending character from the user input; preserve it as data.
placeholders.base: The numeric radix of the literal, such as 2, 8 or 16.

error.integerLimit.meaning: Explains that an integer magnitude exceeds the same allowed maximum in every numeral system.
error.integerLimit.context: Shown when the absolute integer value is greater than 10^30 - 1. The check uses numeric magnitude, not written binary, octal or hexadecimal digit count; allowed values can need up to 100 binary digits. Never truncate, round or wrap the integer to fit.
error.integerLimit.location: Diagnostic associated with the offending literal or calculation result; no valid result is available to copy.

error.baseRequiresUnitlessValue.text: A value with a unit cannot use this numeral-system conversion
error.baseRequiresUnitlessValue.meaning: Explains that numeral-system conversion does not implicitly strip a physical unit or reformat its coefficient.
error.baseRequiresUnitlessValue.context: Shown when a quantity with a unit is given a numeral-system conversion target, such as 5 kg::hex or 5 kg to hex. Unit-bearing quantities use compatible unit conversions instead.
error.baseRequiresUnitlessValue.location: Diagnostic associated with the incompatible conversion target; no valid result is available to copy.

help.precedence.existingAssociativity.text: Already agreed: powers associate left to right, so `2^3^2 = (2^3)^2 = 64`. Power precedes unary minus: `-2^2 = -4`. Multiplication, implicit multiplication and division have equal priority and run left to right: `6/2(1+2) = 9`.

help.precedence.newOrderingExamples.text: Power and unary signs bind before `::`: `2^3::bin = 0b1000` and `-10::hex = -0xA`.

help.precedence.spacingRule.text: The operator determines precedence, regardless of spaces around it. `2+3::hex` and `2 + 3 :: hex` both produce `5`; `2+3 to hex` produces `0x5`. Spaces can still separate tokens or group decimal digits; they cannot be removed arbitrarily from every expression.
help.precedence.spacingRule.meaning: Explains that spaces around an operator do not change its precedence while preserving lexical whitespace rules.

help.precedence.definitionRule.text: `=` defines a name; it is not an equality comparison. Evaluate its right-hand expression using the operator order. Use `==` for equality checks.

help.precedence.unitPowersRule.text: Typing m2 or m3 automatically displays m² or m³; the active Russian equivalents are м2/м3 and м²/м³. These symbols always mean square or cubic metres, never minutes. The caret ^ raises the entire quantity to a power: 2m2 denotes two square metres; 2m^2 denotes four square metres if m has been resolved as a metre. Complex units such as squared seconds and acceleration are excluded. Intermediate dimensions before cancellation, unsupported alternatives and editing boundaries are still being specified.
help.precedence.unitPowersRule.meaning: Explains the accepted new square-unit input and ordinary caret behavior, without deciding unresolved contextual aliases.
help.precedence.unitPowersRule.context: Documentation of accepted contextual-units round 2 decisions: duration sums, all valid alternative answers, explicit aliases and exclusion of complex time-power units. Clauses explicitly marked open do not approve additional grammar, grouping, copy behavior or compound units.

help.precedence.comparisonChains.text: A chain such as `1 < x < 10` compares neighboring values and requires every comparison to hold. It means `1 < x and x < 10`. Stop at the first false comparison; do not compare a Boolean intermediate result with the next number.
help.precedence.comparisonChains.meaning: Explains the accepted pairwise comparison-chain semantics and short-circuit behavior.

help.precedence.lazyUnitsRule.text: Lowercase m can mean a metre or a minute; the active Russian spelling м follows the same rule. Lazy resolution uses the whole formula, including outer parentheses. If multiple interpretations remain valid, show all distinct visible answers: 10m / 2s gives 5m/s or the unitless 300. Identical-looking answers appear once: 2m * 2 displays one 4m. Answers have no interpretation captions and remain in one row with horizontal scrolling when needed. Grouping the display does not discard original meanings or exact values. Explicit metre and min select a unit directly; the Russian equivalents are метр and мин. Ordering and copy selection remain open.
help.precedence.lazyUnitsRule.meaning: Explains that a visible calculated result may retain an unresolved unit symbol instead of forcing a choice.
help.precedence.lazyUnitsRule.context: Accepted contextual-units round 3 presentation: group identical-looking formatted answers, omit result captions and use horizontal overflow only. Preserve underlying interpretations and exact values; no default copy selection is approved.
help.precedence.lazyUnitsRule.location: Unit interpretation section in the in-app operator help and its generated documentation previews.

help.precedence.durationNotation.text: Short duration symbols are w, d, h, m, s and ms. Russian symbols are н, д, ч, м, с and мс. Days remain 24 hours and weeks remain seven days. Adjacent duration components are added: 1h 30m = 90min. Use an explicit * for multiplication. This is a special duration rule, not a general rule for adjacent quantities. Token boundaries without spaces and repeated components remain open.
help.precedence.durationNotation.meaning: Lists the selected short duration notation while separating it from pending duration-chain grammar.

error.unsupportedUnit.meaning: Explains that the calculation requires a unit outside the selected product scope.
error.unsupportedUnit.context: Approved concise diagnostic for an unsupported final unit, such as kg*m, squared seconds or acceleration. Simple compound units are limited to speed, pace and information-transfer rate; area and volume remain supported. Whether to discard one unsupported alternative and when to check intermediate dimensions remain open.
error.unsupportedUnit.location: Calculation diagnostic region when a result requires an excluded unit. Behavior when only one of multiple interpretations is unsupported remains open.

help.precedence.simpleCompoundUnits.text: Supported compound units are speed (length/time, for example km/h), pace (time/length, min/km) and information-transfer rate (information/time, MB/s). Area and volume remain supported. Final units such as kg*m, s² and m/s² are excluded and produce a short unsupported-unit diagnostic. Intermediate dimensions and partly valid sets of interpretations are still being specified. Temperature retains its separate conversion-only rule.
help.precedence.simpleCompoundUnits.meaning: Defines the limited supported compound-unit families while retaining area and volume.
help.precedence.simpleCompoundUnits.context: Accepted in contextual-units round 3. Do not infer support for arbitrary products or scientific derived units. Intermediate cancellation and filtering of unsupported alternatives remain undecided.
